info.text:
Two bad GDP quarters isn't automatically a recession. Here's who decides.
In the US, the NBER calls recessions: a significant decline in economic activity, spread across the economy, lasting more than a few months.
In 2022, GDP fell two quarters in a row and no recession was called.
The Great Recession began in Dec 2007 but was announced in Dec 2008. Unemployment went from 5.0% to 10.0%.
Sources: NBER, BLS.
News and education, not financial advice.
